shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'

/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Button Modal DropdownMenu Text && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components/{Table,Pagination,TextInput,Select,Modal,DropdownMenu,Text,Button} | head -65; ls -a; test ! -d node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons || cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -25'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Button Modal DropdownMenu Text; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt && rg -n 'withTableSorting|withTableSelection|## Pagination|# Table|# TextInput|# Select|CSS API' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt').then(r=>{if("'!r.ok)throw Error(r.status);return r.text()}).then(t=>require('"'fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt',t)).catch(e=>console.log(e.message))\"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md; rg -n 'Magnifier|ArrowDownToLine|Plus|Sliders|Persons|CircleCheck|CircleQuestion|ChevronDown|Ellipsis|ArrowUpRight|Xmark|ArrowRightFromSquare|Layout' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^#.*(Table|Pagination|Select|Button)|disableDataSorting|--g-table|withTableSorting|withTableSelection'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -125; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -130; rg -n 'success|utility|info|warning|brand|selection|positive' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -50; cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "head -20 /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -125; sed -n '90,165p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md; rg -n 'Persons|PersonPlus|Magnifier|Sliders|Plus|CircleDashed|CircleDollar|ArrowRotateRight|Squares4|Bell|Envelope|Moon|Sun' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | tail -35; rg -o -- '--g-color-(base|text)-(positive|info|utility|warning|misc|neutral)[a-z-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u"
